extraction.Name: Nora Tway Sanders
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. recorded 11-20-18, by First National Bank
extraction.Buyer: Deeded to James R. Buff, Pierce, Nebr. for $2550.00 by Nora Tway Sanders and Jesse F. Sanders, Wife & Husb. on May 9, 1919. Recorded May 26, 1919. Mortgaged to Joseph A. Skinner for $500.00, recorded Dec. 3, 1918; mortgage satisfied May 9, 1919 by Joseph A. Skinner.
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 7, 1918. Land described as SE 36-38-34. Jesse F. Sanders is husband. Record taken from the County Seat.
